label: mid-original-phase step in sequences starting with b (or 0) containing 1/w, strongest on j right after 1
explanation: Sparse conjunctive feature: fires almost only in the original phase at steps 3-6 (97% of mass; small leak on the delimiter step when b is output; never fires in the copy phase or at t<3). Firing depends on the prefix: first token b (76% of mass, 21x lift) or 0 (13%), together with a 1 and/or w earlier in the prefix. The input j (59% of mass, 17x) and previous token 1 (55%, 18x) are strongest; the top examples are like b 0 1 w [j], b q a w 1 [j], 0 w 1 [j]. Activation is larger when more of {b/0 first, w, 1 before, j now} hold together. Precision of any simple predicate stays low (about 0.1): many steps with b first and j or post-1 tokens do not fire, so the exact combination of tokens is not captured. Best predicate gets dev F1 0.19 and mass recall 0.64.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+6.93), prev_tok=1 (+4.34), orig0=0 (+3.05), orig1=0 (+2.71), orig1=b (+2.57), prev2_tok=w (+2.53). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.41), prev3_tok=- (-2.11), orig_idx=-1 (-1.76), phase=2 (-1.54).
